services.name: 2 Hr Shark Tooth Excursion
services.desc: Duration: 2 hours About One of our most requested jet ski adventures, this guided experience takes you on an unforgettable ride south from Surf City, NC to the pristine barrier islands of Lea Island or Rich’s Inlet. Follow your expert guide through scenic coastal waterways before pulling up to remote islands for hands-on shark tooth hunting and shell exploring. Choose between up to one full hour of island exploration at Lea Island or a 30-minute stop at Rich’s Inlet, depending on conditions and your group’s pace. These undeveloped barrier islands are known for shark teeth, unique shells, and incredible coastal wildlife, so keep your eyes open—you never know what you’ll spot along the way.

services.name: 2 Hr Figure 8 Island Excursion
services.desc: Want to get more from your jet ski experience? Guided rides are the way to go! Duration: 2 hours About Set out on an epic guided jet ski tour along the coast of Topsail Island, led by an experienced, professionally trained guide. This long-distance adventure takes you south through stunning coastal waterways to Wrightsville Beach and Figure Eight Island, covering approximately 50 miles round trip of unforgettable riding. Your guide will tailor the pace to your group—whether you’re craving a fast, adrenaline-filled jet ski ride or a smooth, scenic coastal cruise. services.desc: Ready to experience the thrill of jumping waves and riding the open ocean like never before? Duration: 2 hours About Experience the ultimate 2-hour guided jet ski adventure through Surf City’s stunning coastal waters. Your journey begins along the Intracoastal Waterway (ICWW), weaving through Banks Channel on the way to the breathtaking Lea Island Inlet. Once you arrive at the inlet, get ready for some high-energy thrills—this is where you can find perfect rolling waves that launch you and your jet ski into the air, creating unforgettable moments of exhilaration. services.name: 2 Hr Onslow Shore Excursion
services.desc: Want to get more from your jet ski experience? Guided rides are the way to go! Duration: 2 hours About Explore North Carolina’s coast on our 2-hour guided Swansboro Jet Ski Tour, departing from Surf City. Ride through the calm waters of Topsail Island, heading north along the scenic, less-developed shoreline of Onslow Beach and into the natural beauty of Hammocks Beach State Park. This guided tour is perfect for all experience levels, offering stunning coastal views, smooth riding waters, and opportunities to spot dolphins and coastal wildlife. A local guide leads the way, giving you opportunities to experience the local ecosystems and wildlife. A perfect mix of adventure and sightseeing --

faq.q: 1: How old do you have to be?
faq.a: We require that renters/operators be a minimum of 18 years old, however, you can drive the ski at 16 years old with parent/guardian permission. Children 18 and younger are allowed as passengers, but are left up to the parent’s discretion. We recommend no children younger than 5 years old ride as passengers. 2: Do I have to make reservations? Although reservations are not required, it is STRONGLY recommended you make reservations to ensure availability.
